entities.name: Abeena
entities.description: A Kor hookslinger from Zendikar who fought in Gideon's forces and helped establish Sky Rock Refuge.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the Zendikari forces and received command of the army.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: Ally who Abeena told of Vorik's dying.

entities.name: Vorik
entities.description: A commander who was dying and gave last orders to Tazri and Gideon.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The war during which Abeena fought as part of Gideon's forces.

entities.name: Sky Rock Refuge
entities.description: A hedron camp with floating rock waterfalls where survivors gathered.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A place the army announced it would reclaim.

events.summary: Abeena helps Gideon reposition a floating waterfall so its water rains onto the hedron camp.
events.quote: Abeena helped Gideon to reposition the nearest floating rock waterfall of Sky Rock Refuge

events.summary: Abeena anchors a rope and turns the waterfall; the Zendikari cheer and drink beneath the stream.
events.quote: A final yank heaved the waterfall straight over Sky Rock.

events.summary: Abeena tells Tazri and Gideon that Vorik is dying and relays his orders.
events.quote: Abeena broke the news to Tazri and Gideon that Vorik was dying

events.summary: Gideon takes command and announces the reclaiming of the Sea Gate; Abeena cheers.
events.quote: After Gideon received command of the army, Abeena was among the many who cheered

relations.quote: who fought as part of Gideon 's forces during the Battle for Zendikar
